data.name: coolify
data.description: An open-source, self-hostable PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku & Netlify that lets you easily deploy static sites, databases, full-stack applications and 360+ one-click services on your own servers.

data.name: v4.4.7
data.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release fixes multiple critical CVEs in dependencies that Coolify uses. Update immediately.

> [!TIP]
> Every v4 line has a security fix release. On v4.4, update from the dashboard: `Settings → Update → Check now → Update`. We recommend that everyone moves to v4.4.7, because the v4.1, v4.2, v4.3, v4.4 minior releases also include other security fixes that are not backported.
>
> To update to a patched version of v4.0 to v4.3, run this on your server to update to the security fix release of your line:
>
> ```bash
> curl -fsSL https://cdn.coollabs.io/coolify/patch.sh | sudo bash
> ```
>
> | Running | Security fix release |
> |---|---|
> | v4.0.x | v4.0.1 |
> | v4.1.x | v4.1.3 |
> | v4.2.x | v4.2.1 |
> | v4.3.x | v4.3.24 |
> | v4.4.x | v4.4.7 |
>
> The script requires a stable release (not a beta, RC, or nightly).
> 
> On a v4 beta or older release? First install the v4.0.1 security fix release manually by running the command below, then update to v4.4.7 right away from the dashboard (`Settings → Update → Check > now → Update`):
>
>  ```bash
>  curl -fsSL https://cdn.coollabs.io/coolify/install.sh | sudo bash -s 4.0.1
> ```
>

## Security

- Updated PHP to 8.4.27 to fix PHP2Shell ([CVE-2026-109618](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-109618), [CVE-2026-109619](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-109619)).
- Updated Node.js to [24.22.1](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v24.22.1) for the terminal server and the asset build.
- Updated cloudflared to [2026.10.3](https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/tag/2026.10.3) for the [eMudhra certificate compromise](https://blog.cloudflare.com/emudhra-certificate-compromise/).
- Updated Sentinel to [1.1.2](https://github.com/coollabsio/sentinel/releases/tag/v1.1.2) to fix [CVE-2026-111943](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-111943).

## Issues 

- fixes https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/issues/12266

+name: Sync main to next
+
+on:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+  pull-requests: write
+
+concurrency:
+  group: sync-main-to-next
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  sync:
+    name: Merge main into next
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Merge main into next
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
+          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
+          git fetch origin main next
+          git checkout --quiet -B next origin/next
+
+          if git merge --no-edit origin/main; then
+            git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/next
+            exit 0
+          fi
+
+          conflicts=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)
+          git merge --abort
+
+          if [ -z "$conflicts" ]; then
+            echo '::error title=main to next sync failed::The merge failed without conflicts, so no pull request was created.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          sync_branch='automation/sync-main-to-next'
+          existing_pr=$(gh pr list --base next --head "$sync_branch" --state open --json url --jq '.[0].url')
+          if [ -n "$existing_pr" ]; then
+            # The conflict was already reported when this pull request was opened.
+            # Stay green until it is merged instead of failing every scheduled run.
+            echo "::notice title=main to next sync blocked::main still conflicts with next; resolve the open pull request: $existing_pr"
+            exit 0
+          fi
+
+          git push --force origin origin/main:"refs/heads/$sync_branch"
+          gh pr create \
+            --base next \
+            --head "$sync_branch" \
+            --title 'chore: merge main into next' \
+            --body 'This pull request was created automatically because main could not be merged into next without conflicts. Resolve conflicts on this temporary branch; never update main with next.'
+
+          echo '::error title=main to next sync blocked::main could not be merged into next without conflicts; a pull request was opened to resolve them.'
+          exit 1
